items.what: Venue of Afghanistan v Bangladesh 3rd ODI
items.detail: ACB briefing (via Ariana News) says the last two tri-series matches are in Sharjah; ESPNcricinfo's scorecard header says Sharjah while another ESPNcricinfo match page shows Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi. Venue left out of the table rather than guessed.

items.what: Sharjah vs Abu Dhabi for the same fixture
items.detail: Two pages on the same publisher disagree about the ground; recorded as a flag and not resolved by us.

items.what: OLBG start times are timezone-rendered
items.detail: OLBG serves relative labels ('Today', 'Tomorrow') plus a clock time in the viewer's timezone. Cross-checking the same darts fixtures against dated PDC listings shows a 5-hour offset (PDC 18:15 UK rendered by OLBG as 'Tomorrow 13:15'). We therefore print OLBG's label verbatim and do NOT convert; treat every start time as provisional.

items.what: Fixture and format not on the official WST site
items.detail: WST's site confirms the event, venue and date but the per-match order of play used here comes from snooker.org, an independent archive. Flagged rather than presented as official.

items.what: Head-to-head record excluded
items.detail: Secondary sites gave conflicting head-to-head tallies for Fernandez v Sasnovich, and no official WTA head-to-head page was captured, so no H2H claim is made anywhere.

items.what: OLBG paginates its tip lists
items.detail: Every sport page carries a 'Load More Tips' control and lazy-loaded cards. The inventory is the first page of each sport exactly as served at capture, so it is a complete record of what OLBG showed first, not necessarily every fixture OLBG holds.

items.what: No match fixtures at capture
items.detail: OLBG's rugby league page served only 2027 outright markets (State of Origin, Super League, NRL) and no upcoming fixtures. Reported as empty rather than padded with invented matches.

items.what: One fixture only
items.detail: Only one MLB game (TB Rays @ MIL Brewers) was listed on the captured page, consistent with the postseason schedule. Not padded.

items.what: Races are minute-by-minute snapshots
items.detail: Greyhound cards turn over every few minutes; the six races recorded here had already expired by the time of publication. They are kept as examples of the capture format, not as live fixtures.

items.what: No golf rows captured
items.detail: Golf tipsters are listed by OLBG but no golf fixture rows were served on the pages captured; OLBG's golf sport id was not observed and no id is invented.

items.what: Outright-only sport
items.detail: Motor racing on OLBG is race-winner/futures betting with no head-to-head match lines, so it cannot carry a per-match line. No id observed in this capture.

items.what: Some excluded OLBG ids were not observed
items.detail: Football (1), Horse Racing (2), American Football (11) and Boxing/UFC/MMA (16) ids were confirmed from live pages. Hurling, Cycling and Specials were on the exclusion list but their ids were not observed, so they are left null in data/sports.json instead of guessed.

items.what: Competition names for tennis, snooker, cricket, darts, handball, volleyball, rugby
items.detail: OLBG's list rows for these sports do not print a competition name (they do for NBA/EuroLeague/EHL etc.). The competition column is left blank on the board instead of being inferred from tournament dates.

items.what: Excluded sport present in the other build

items.what: Two sports with outright markets only
items.detail: Build A lists Golf and Motor Racing as included sports. Both are race/tournament-winner markets with no head-to-head match lines, so they cannot carry a per-match line; build B could not capture either as a match sport (OLBG ids not observed).
